question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

MAGNANIMOUS
solution:
The correct answer is '**Charitable**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Magnanimous**' is '**Charitable**'.
 
• **Magnanimous**: kind, generous, and forgiving (especially towards an enemy or a competitor that you have beaten). [दयालु, उदार और क्षमाशील (विशेषतः पराजित शत्रु या प्रतियोगी के प्रति)]
 
 
• *Example: His heart was kind and his affections were strong; he was **magnanimous** and disinterested, simple and honest.*
 
 
 
• **Charitable**: kind; generous. (दयालु; उदार)
 
 
• *Example: More funds will now be allocated to **charitable** organizations.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Charitable.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Unstable**: likely to fall down or move; not firmly fixed. (जो कभी भी गिर या हिल सकता है, अस्थिर; जो मज़बूती से स्‍थापित नहीं, ढुलमुल)
 
• **Suspicious**: feeling that somebody has done something wrong, dishonest or illegal. (जिसे किसी बात के ग़लत, अनुचित या ग़ैर-क़ानूनी होने का अहसास हो, संदेही या संशयी, संदेहग्रस्‍त या संशयग्रस्‍त)
 
• **Malicious**: characterized by malice; intending or intended to do harm. (विद्वेषी, दुर्भावनाशील)
